Korea's birthrate rises at fastest pace on record in Q1

queries.summary: Births have increased for 23 consecutive months since July 2024; births rose 11.1 percent in July from a year earlier, marking the 25th consecutive month of increases. The number of births in May reached 23,160, up 2,781, or 13.6%. A total of 24,275 babies were born in July, up from 21,854 a year earlier. A total of 122,694 babies were born from January through May, up 15.2%. April saw 20,622 registered marriages, up 9.0 percent year on year. The number of marriages fell 6.4 per cent year-on-year to 20,368 in May, though marriages in July rose 9.3 percent to 22,282. The echo boom generation born 1991-1995 is entering peak marrying years.

queries.summary: The number of births in Japan rose in the first half of the year for the first time in 11 years. The preliminary data showed that the number of births in the January-June period edged up by 2,788, or 0.8 percent, to 342,068. The number of marriages grew by 418 to 238,979 in the first six months of the year, while divorces fell by 3,578 to 90,177. Deaths totaled 778,982.
